videos.title: The Truth About People Who Peaked Early
videos.description:
Notion: Learn more about how Notion can support your business at https://notion.com/solved
Quo: Try QUO for free PLUS get 20% off your first 6 months when you go to https://quo.com/solved

There are two ways to fail. One teaches you something. The other just makes you hate yourself. The difference comes down to whether you're chasing your own growth or other people's approval. Drew and I explore this concept through tennis legend Andre Agassi, who made it to number one in the world and was miserable. We also explain why Google sat on the technology behind ChatGPT for years, the difference between "I messed up" and "I'm a mess," and a simple mental trick that helps you bounce back from failure without beating yourself up.

Get your free episode guide: https://mrk.mn/failureguide
